title: 66 Arrow Schema
description: JSON Schema for a directed relationship (Arrow) between two StatuNodes in the 66 topological layer

id.description: Unique identifier for this arrow within its Arrow Map

source.description: ID of the originating StatuNode. May be a URI (statuz:node:<id>) or a local ID resolved within the map's namespace

target.description: ID of the receiving StatuNode. May be a URI or a local ID

type.description: The semantic meaning of this relationship. Each type has defined executable semantics.

description.description: REQUIRED. Human-readable explanation of why this arrow exists and what relationship it represents. Every arrow must have a meaningful description for semantic understanding.
examples: CLI depends on SDK-TS for YAML file read/write operations and schema validation
Auth service receives user credentials from API gateway via information_flow
Platform team is responsible for maintaining shared infrastructure components

properties.description: Type-specific metadata for this arrow. Structure varies by arrow type.

criticality.description: How severely the source would be affected if this arrow were broken

weight.description: Numeric strength of the relationship (0.0 = weak, 1.0 = strong)

type_properties.description: Extended properties specific to the arrow type. For dependency: dependency_type (hard/soft/optional), failure_mode. For information_flow: direction (unidirectional/bidirectional), information_type, protocol. For responsibility: responsibility_scope, escalation_path. For validation: validation_type (approval/review/test/audit), required. For resource_transfer: resource_type, allocation. For influence: influence_mechanism. For constraint: constraint_type (temporal/spatial/logical/policy), constraint_expression.

temporal.description: Optional time bounds for when this arrow is active

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering and categorization

confidence.description: Confidence that this arrow actually exists (1.0 = confirmed, 0.0 = speculative)

detector_id.description: ID of the detector that discovered this arrow
